disclaimer: AstroCare provides general decision support only. It does not diagnose or treat any condition and does not replace a flight surgeon or qualified medical professional.
immediateSafetyInstructions: Notify another crew member now; do not wait to finish the questions.
Follow the approved onboard medical emergency protocol.
Contact the designated crew medical officer / Flight Surgeon when communication is available.
If Earth communication is delayed, continue the approved onboard emergency procedure.

contactByEnvironment.iss: Use the onboard communication loop to reach Mission Control and the Flight Surgeon.
contactByEnvironment.spacecraft: Use the primary communication channel to the Flight Surgeon; expect possible delay and alert the crew first.
contactByEnvironment.moon_base: Alert the crew in the habitat, then contact the Flight Surgeon via the surface-to-Earth link; expect possible delay.

questions.text: Is the pain severe, crushing, or spreading to your arm, jaw, neck, or back?
Do you also have shortness of breath, cold sweat, or nausea?
Are you feeling faint, dizzy, or about to pass out?
Has the pain lasted more than 5 minutes or is it getting worse?
Do you have a known heart condition or has this happened before?

outcomeRule: emergency_now if any of CP-Q1..CP-Q4 is 'yes' or 'unsure'; otherwise urgent_contact. Both outcomes keep the immediate safety instructions visible and the alert level critical.

outcomes.emergency_now: Treat this as an emergency. Keep following the safety instructions and get medical help right now.
outcomes.urgent_contact: Chest pain still requires urgent evaluation. Follow the same immediate safety instructions, even when all questionnaire answers are negative.
